package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type validationRepositoryFake struct {
	ports.Repository
	instance      domain.TaskInstance
	submission    domain.Submission
	intent        domain.SubmitIntent
	runStarted    bool
	completed     bool
	enqueued      bool
	retryCreated  bool
	evidence      json.RawMessage
	finalInstance domain.TaskInstance
}

func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) GetInstanceByID(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if id != repository.instance.ID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.instance, nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) GetSubmission(_ context.Context, taskInstanceID, submissionID string) (domain.Submission, error) {
	if taskInstanceID != repository.submission.TaskInstanceID || submissionID != repository.submission.ID {
		return domain.Submission{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.submission, nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) GetValidationContextByRunID(_ context.Context, runID string) (domain.TaskInstance, domain.Submission, error) {
	for _, run := range repository.submission.ValidationRuns {
		if run.ID == runID {
			return repository.instance, repository.submission, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.Submission{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) GetIntent(_ context.Context, _, _ string) (domain.SubmitIntent, error) {
	return repository.intent, nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) SetRunRunning(context.Context, string, time.Time) error {
	repository.runStarted = true
	return nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) CompleteValidation(_ context.Context, submission domain.Submission, _ domain.ValidationRun, instance domain.TaskInstance) error {
	repository.completed = true
	repository.submission, repository.instance = submission, instance
	return nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) CompleteInstanceAndEnqueueEvidence(_ context.Context, instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission, payload json.RawMessage) error {
	repository.enqueued = true
	repository.finalInstance, repository.submission, repository.evidence = instance, submission, payload
	return nil
}
func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) CreateValidationRetry(_ context.Context, submission domain.Submission, _ domain.ValidationRun) error {
	repository.retryCreated = true
	repository.submission = submission
	return nil
}

type validationWorkspaceFake struct {
	locks   []ports.LockWorkspaceWrites
	unlocks []ports.UnlockWorkspaceWrites
}

func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) CreateOrResumeWorkspace(context.Context, ports.CreateWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	panic("not used")
}
func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) FreezeSnapshot(context.Context, ports.FreezeSnapshot) (domain.SnapshotRef, error) {
	panic("not used")
}
func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) ReadPinnedSnapshot(context.Context, domain.SnapshotRef) (ports.WorkspaceSnapshot, error) {
	panic("not used")
}
func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) LockWrites(_ context.Context, input ports.LockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	workspace.locks = append(workspace.locks, input)
	return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{LockID: "permanent-lock", FenceEpoch: 9, Permanent: input.Mode == "PERMANENT"}, nil
}
func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) UnlockWrites(_ context.Context, input ports.UnlockWorkspaceWrites) (ports.WorkspaceWriteLock, error) {
	workspace.unlocks = append(workspace.unlocks, input)
	return ports.WorkspaceWriteLock{LockID: input.LockID, FenceEpoch: 8}, nil
}
func (workspace *validationWorkspaceFake) RestoreWorkspace(context.Context, ports.RestoreWorkspace) (domain.WorkspaceBinding, error) {
	panic("not used")
}

type validationPortFake struct {
	result domain.ValidationResult
	err    error
}

type validationSequenceFake struct {
	requests []ports.OfficialValidationRequest
	failNext bool
}

func (validator *validationSequenceFake) ValidateOfficialSubmission(_ context.Context, input ports.OfficialValidationRequest) (domain.ValidationResult, error) {
	validator.requests = append(validator.requests, input)
	if validator.failNext {
		validator.failNext = false
		return domain.ValidationResult{}, context.DeadlineExceeded
	}
	return validationResultForIdentity(input), nil
}

func (validator validationPortFake) ValidateOfficialSubmission(context.Context, ports.OfficialValidationRequest) (domain.ValidationResult, error) {
	return validator.result, validator.err
}

func TestMismatchedValidationEchoBecomesErrorAndKeepsFence(t *testing.T) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission, intent: domain.SubmitIntent{WriteLockID: "temporary-lock", FenceEpoch: 7}}
	workspace := &validationWorkspaceFake{}
	result := validationResultFor(instance, submission, pending.RunID)
	result.SubmissionID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099"
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, Validator: validationPortFake{result: result}, Now: func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
	if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !repository.runStarted || !repository.completed || repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].Status != domain.ValidationRunError ||
		repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].ErrorClassification != ClassificationProtocol || len(workspace.unlocks) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("mismatched validator response did not fail closed: repository=%+v workspace=%+v", repository, workspace)
	}
}

func TestValidationErrorRetryUsesSamePinnedSnapshotAndNeverCreatesFailureEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	instance.Steps[0].Status = "AVAILABLE"
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission, intent: domain.SubmitIntent{WriteLockID: "temporary-lock", FenceEpoch: 7}}
	workspace := &validationWorkspaceFake{}
	validator := &validationSequenceFake{failNext: true}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, Validator: validator,
		NewID: func() string { return "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000021" },
		Now:   func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
	if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if repository.submission.Status != domain.SubmissionValidating || repository.instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceValidating ||
		repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].Status != domain.ValidationRunError || repository.enqueued || len(repository.evidence) != 0 || len(workspace.unlocks) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("technical ERROR changed learner result or emitted evidence: submission=%+v instance=%+v", repository.submission, repository.instance)
	}
	firstSnapshot := repository.submission.Snapshot
	if firstSnapshot != submission.Snapshot {
		t.Fatalf("first run snapshot = %+v, want pinned S1 %+v", firstSnapshot, submission.Snapshot)
	}
	if _, err := runtime.RetryValidation(context.Background(), pending.RunID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("retry same Submission after ERROR: %v", err)
	}
	newRunID := repository.submission.ValidationRuns[1].ID
	newPending := pending
	newPending.RunID = newRunID
	if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), newPending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(validator.requests) != 2 || validator.requests[0].Snapshot != firstSnapshot || validator.requests[1].Snapshot != firstSnapshot ||
		validator.requests[0].Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest != validator.requests[1].Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest ||
		validator.requests[0].ValidationRunID == validator.requests[1].ValidationRunID {
		t.Fatalf("validation retry did not retain immutable S1: %+v", validator.requests)
	}
	if repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].Status != domain.ValidationRunError || repository.submission.ValidationRuns[1].Status != domain.ValidationRunPassed ||
		repository.submission.ID != submission.ID || repository.instance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceInProgress {
		t.Fatalf("retry did not preserve one Submission and produce a successful later run: %+v %+v", repository.submission, repository.instance)
	}
}

func TestFinalPassCompletesAndEnqueuesDeterministicEvidenceAfterPermanentFence(t *testing.T) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceValidating
	instance.CurrentSubmissionID = submission.ID
	instance.Steps[0].Status = "PASSED"
	instance.AssistancePolicyVersion = AssistancePolicyVersion
	submission.Scope, submission.Status = "FINAL", domain.SubmissionValidating
	submission.ValidationRuns[0].Status = domain.ValidationRunPending
	submission.RequiresHumanReview = false
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission,
		intent: domain.SubmitIntent{WriteLockID: "temporary-lock", FenceEpoch: 7}}
	workspace := &validationWorkspaceFake{}
	result := validationResultFor(instance, submission, pending.RunID)
	result.Outcome = domain.OutcomePass
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: workspace, Validator: validationPortFake{result: result}, Now: func() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 10, 2, 2, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }}
	if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(workspace.locks) != 1 || workspace.locks[0].Mode != "PERMANENT" || repository.completed || !repository.enqueued || repository.finalInstance.Status != domain.TaskInstanceCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("final PASS did not complete behind permanent lock: workspace=%+v repository=%+v", workspace, repository)
	}
	var payload struct {
		Schema             string                 `json:"schema"`
		Evidence           []ports.TargetEvidence `json:"evidence"`
		Outcome            string                 `json:"outcome"`
		Policy             string                 `json:"policy_version"`
		EvidenceID         string                 `json:"evidence_id"`
		LearningActionID   string                 `json:"learning_action_id"`
		TaskRevisionDigest string                 `json:"task_revision_digest"`
		WorkspaceDigest    string                 `json:"workspace_digest"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(repository.evidence, &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if payload.Schema != EvidenceSchemaV2 || payload.Outcome != "passed" || payload.Policy != EvidencePolicyV2 || payload.EvidenceID != submission.ID ||
		payload.LearningActionID != instance.LearningActionID || payload.TaskRevisionDigest != instance.TaskRevisionDigest || payload.WorkspaceDigest != submission.WorkspaceDigest ||
		len(payload.Evidence) != 1 || payload.Evidence[0].Correctness != 1 || payload.Evidence[0].Confidence != 1 || payload.Evidence[0].Independence != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected Student evidence payload: %+v", payload)
	}
}

func TestRetryValidationRequiresPathRunToBeLatestErroredRun(t *testing.T) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	submission.ValidationRuns[0].Status = domain.ValidationRunError
	olderRunID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000098"
	submission.ValidationRuns = append([]domain.ValidationRun{{ID: olderRunID, Status: domain.ValidationRunError}}, submission.ValidationRuns...)
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, NewID: func() string { return "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000021" }}
	if _, err := runtime.RetryValidation(context.Background(), olderRunID); err == nil || repository.retryCreated {
		t.Fatal("retry accepted a path run ID that is not the latest errored run")
	}
	if _, err := runtime.RetryValidation(context.Background(), pending.RunID); err != nil || !repository.retryCreated {
		t.Fatalf("retry rejected the latest errored run: %v", err)
	}
}

func validationFixtures() (domain.TaskInstance, domain.Submission, ports.PendingValidation) {
	instanceID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
	studentID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
	submissionID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010"
	runID := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011"
	instance := domain.TaskInstance{ID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, TaskRevisionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", LearningActionID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
		Status: domain.TaskInstanceValidating, CurrentSubmissionID: submissionID, WorkspaceBinding: domain.WorkspaceBinding{SandboxID: "sandbox-1"},
		Steps: []domain.Step{{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005", Required: true, Status: "PASSED", Targets: []domain.Target{{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}}}}}
	submission := domain.Submission{ID: submissionID, TaskInstanceID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, Scope: "MILESTONE", Status: domain.SubmissionValidating,
		MilestoneID: instance.Steps[0].ID, Snapshot: domain.SnapshotRef{SandboxID: "sandbox-1", SnapshotID: "snapshot-1", GenerationID: "generation-1", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"},
		WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", RevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest,
		ValidationContractDigest: "sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc", ValidationSpecification: json.RawMessage(`{"schema":"practice-validation-specification.v1"}`),
		IdempotencyKey: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012", ValidationRuns: []domain.ValidationRun{{ID: runID, Status: domain.ValidationRunPending}}}
	return instance, submission, ports.PendingValidation{TaskInstanceID: instanceID, StudentID: studentID, SubmissionID: submissionID, RunID: runID}
}

func validationResultFor(instance domain.TaskInstance, submission domain.Submission, runID string) domain.ValidationResult {
	return domain.ValidationResult{TaskInstanceID: instance.ID, SubmissionID: submission.ID, ValidationRunID: runID,
		RevisionDigest: instance.TaskRevisionDigest, ValidationContractDigest: submission.ValidationContractDigest,
		Snapshot: submission.Snapshot, Outcome: domain.OutcomePass}
}

func validationResultForIdentity(input ports.OfficialValidationRequest) domain.ValidationResult {
	return domain.ValidationResult{TaskInstanceID: input.TaskInstanceID, SubmissionID: input.SubmissionID, ValidationRunID: input.ValidationRunID,
		RevisionDigest: input.RevisionDigest, ValidationContractDigest: input.ValidationContractDigest,
		Snapshot: input.Snapshot, Outcome: domain.OutcomePass}
}

// TestT12OfficialStagesSurvivePersistence uses the existing result API and a
// JSON reconstruction to reproduce lost provider stages before production edits.
func TestT12OfficialStagesSurvivePersistence(t *testing.T) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission, intent: domain.SubmitIntent{WriteLockID: "temporary-lock", FenceEpoch: 7}}
	result := validationResultFor(instance, submission, pending.RunID)
	result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeFail
	result.Stages = []domain.ValidationStage{{StageID: "html-structure", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []domain.ValidationIssue{{Code: "MISSING_ELEMENT", Message: "PRIVATE_EVALUATION_CANARY"}}}}
	runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Workspace: &validationWorkspaceFake{}, Validator: validationPortFake{result: result}}
	if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), pending); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(repository.submission)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var reloaded domain.Submission
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &reloaded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	public, err := json.Marshal(reloaded.PublicProjection())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var projected struct {
		Current *struct {
			RunID  string                   `json:"validation_run_id"`
			Stages []domain.ValidationStage `json:"stages"`
		} `json:"current_validation_summary"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(public, &projected); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if projected.Current == nil || projected.Current.RunID != pending.RunID || len(projected.Current.Stages) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("official FAIL stages discarded after reconstruction: %s", public)
	}
	if projected.Current.Stages[0].Issues[0].Message == "PRIVATE_EVALUATION_CANARY" {
		t.Fatal("raw validator message exposed")
	}
}

func TestT12ValidationUnknownClassAndWrongIdentityDiscardProviderDetails(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"unknown error class", "class on pass", "wrong snapshot", "provider error"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
			repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission}
			result := validationResultFor(instance, submission, pending.RunID)
			result.Stages = []domain.ValidationStage{{StageID: "html", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []domain.ValidationIssue{{Code: "MISSING", Message: "PRIVATE_CANARY"}}}}
			validator := validationPortFake{result: result}
			switch mode {
			case "unknown error class":
				validator.result.Outcome = domain.OutcomeError
				validator.result.ErrorClassification = "PRIVATE_CANARY"
			case "class on pass":
				validator.result.ErrorClassification = "PRIVATE_CANARY"
			case "wrong snapshot":
				validator.result.Snapshot.SnapshotID = "foreign-snapshot"
			case "provider error":
				validator.err = fmt.Errorf("PRIVATE_CANARY validator output")
			}
			runtime := Runtime{Repository: repository, Validator: validator}
			if err := runtime.ProcessValidation(context.Background(), pending); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			run := repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0]
			if run.Outcome != domain.OutcomeError || run.SafeSummary == nil || len(run.SafeSummary.Stages) != 0 || run.SafeSummary.ErrorClassification == nil || *run.SafeSummary.ErrorClassification != run.ErrorClassification {
				t.Fatalf("invalid provider result was accepted: %+v", run)
			}
			encoded, _ := json.Marshal(repository.submission)
			if strings.Contains(string(encoded), "PRIVATE_CANARY") || strings.Contains(string(encoded), "foreign-snapshot") {
				t.Fatalf("untrusted result details were retained: %s", encoded)
			}
		})
	}
}
